claims.summary: In every characteristic other than two, for N>=6 with nonzero generic degree-two initial minor, there exist full-degree root-affine pencils with distinct slopes and all pair-collision parameters distinct but every actual reduced maximal cofactor divisible by x^s at a noncollision point, s=floor((floor(N/2)-1)/2). In positive characteristic the pencil can lie in a finite extension and every norm is divisible by x^(e*s).
claims.assessment: Working proof: apply the existing paired-branch jet defect to the length-D+1 prefix, transfer through the invertible source frame, and choose a direction outside finitely many proper hyperplanes and the initial-minor zero set. The bad pencil is exceptional, not a refutation of generic cofactor primitivity.
claims.rationale: Route-specific obstruction to replacing explicit norm gcd checks by collision separation. Consequence of the existing reflection theorem and an elementary open-set argument; no independent novelty claim. The original uniform threshold remains open.
claims.next_action: Test actual root-variation normal maps to distinguish local codimension-two defects from a cofactor divisor.
